description: Value a token rollup in USD at a point in time, using the shared cache multipliers (cache read 0.1x input, cache write 1.25x for 5m / 2x for 1h). tokens accepts input, output, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h. Defaults to today if no date is given.

model.description: Model id or alias to price the usage against.

provider.description: Optional provider slug to disambiguate a bare id.

tokens.description: Token counts to value. All fields optional and non-negative; missing fields count as 0.

name: cost_from_usage
title: Cost from token usage
